probes.hint: hold full throttle in top gear for 5 s

probes.label: Tires warm (> 150 F) most of the run
probes.hint: keep driving — tires still cold for most frames

advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 12/13 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.793 over 13 corners (12 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.71 / R 1.00; 2/2 stops locked both

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 13.95; 1/1 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.67) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.

tests.label: Dyno rev sweep
tests.why: full-throttle through the usable rev range — missing rpm: 2500 — roll onto full throttle from low rpm in a tall gear for the low bins; hold WOT to the shift point for the high ones · band capped at your gearbox's upshift point (~8450 rpm)
